entities.name: BYD
entities.summary: 比亚迪 (SZSE:002594 / HKEX:1211). World's largest NEV maker by volume; world #2 EV-battery supplier behind CATL; deepest-integrated EV company globally — internally builds cells, packs, motors, controllers, IGBT/SiC modules, drivetrains, BMS, MCUs, sensors, plus glass/lights/seats/displays. Sold 4.6 m vehicles in 2025 (2.25 m BEV, 2.29 m PHEV, 1.05 m exports). FY2025 revenue ¥804 bn; net profit ¥27.6 bn TTM (post a sharp 55% Q1-2026 yoy drop). A-share market cap ~USD 137 bn at ¥97.15. TTM P/E ~29×.

entities.name: BYD Electronic
entities.summary: 比亚迪电子 (HKEX:0285). 65.76%-owned BYD subsidiary; tier-1 electronics ODM for Apple (iPad/HomePod/iPhone assembly), Honor, Xiaomi, Samsung, plus emerging AI-server/liquid-cooling/high-speed-interconnect lines. FY2025 segment revenue ¥155.2 bn (19.31% of group), 6.29% gross margin.
